metadata.description: Emanuele Ballarin's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: mf
plugins.description: mindfunnel: project-agnostic Claude Code session management. /mf:dump consolidates session state into auto-memory; /mf:spinup reads it back; /mf:setup and /mf:prime handle first-time and per-project scaffolding.

plugins.name: ccsci
plugins.description: Research & scientific-computing skills adapted from Claude Science for stock Claude Code: literature-review, pdf-explore, figure-style, figure-composer, paper-narrative, canvas-design, doc-coauthoring, web-artifacts-builder, plus computational-scientist and deep-researcher subagents.

plugins.name: ar
plugins.description: autoresearch: a skill-only autonomous experiment loop — propose → measure → keep winners → repeat, against any numeric objective, with noise-floor gating so nothing is banked on noise. /ar:start, /ar:resume, /ar:status, /ar:report, /ar:stop. State stays in the target repo's ./.ar/. No hooks, no MCP.

plugins.name: tml
plugins.description: tuneml: a read-first advisor for training and evaluating neural networks well — the scientific method for tuning and the speed↔quality frontier in one place. /tml:audit ranks graded, priced findings across the algorithmic, systems, protocol and architecture tiers; /tml:plan fixes an operating point and a step budget; /tml:round designs the next experiment, splitting hyperparameters into scientific, nuisance and fixed; /tml:analyze runs the diagnostic checklist and returns a variance-aware adopt verdict; /tml:review adversarially checks a change. Runs local or remote, and analyses results it did not produce. Supersedes parml. No hooks, no MCP.
